flagged_items.summary: Discussion-scan false-flagged Hub Bot's own public welcome post as a member thread needing attention
flagged_items.detail: discussion_check flagged thread 807f6f21 ('Welcome our newest members!', 0 comments, needs_attention true). This is Hub Bot's own public welcome post from 2026-08-15 (confirmed via Aug-15 ledger welcomes_posted public_post entry with that exact title in General). The scan excludes Hub Bot's AI-news post thread IDs from ledgers, but the public welcome post thread ID is not persisted in the ledger, so the exclusion set missed it. This is a variant of defect class #1 (discussion-scan false-flagging HubBot's own posts) — the existing fix excludes known AI-news thread IDs + filters by author name, but the public welcome post is neither.
flagged_items.recommended_action: Persist the public welcome post thread ID in the ledger (e.g. a welcome_post_thread_id field alongside welcomes_posted) and add it to the discussion-scan exclusion set, OR extend the scan's title filter to skip threads whose title exactly matches the canonical welcome-post title pattern ('Welcome our newest members!'). Owner action: none required — no duplicate comment was posted.
